verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a hardware key that ships companion software such as the nitropy CLI, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. The open-source firmware and licensing items are related but different facts and do not document an opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
